findings.message: Stream 1 is coded as PCM (format tag 0x0001), which has no parser here; its media objects are not analyzed.
The records of the Advanced Content Encryption Object (Windows Media DRM for network devices) name only streams that the file does not have, so it protects none.
An Encrypted Object Record names stream 5, which no Stream Properties Object describes; the record protects nothing in this file.
